title: thymus longiflorus subsp. ciliatus
intro: Thymus longiflorus subsp. ciliatus, commonly known as the 'Ciliated Thyme', is a subspecies of the thyme plant that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments such as respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Thymus longiflorus subsp. ciliatus include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce stress and anxiety, and act as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
